title: carex rigida var. goodenowii
intro: Carex rigida var. goodenowii, commonly known as Good's Sedge, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Carex rigida var. goodenowii include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relieve coughs and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
